mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wms_env_data (device_id, online, temperature, humidity, collect_time, receive_time) VALUES
( #{item.deviceId}, #{item.online}, #{item.temperature}, #{item.humidity}, #{item.collectTime}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.device_id, t.online, t.temperature, t.humidity, t.collect_time, t.receive_time, c.device_name, c.warehouse, c.device_type, c.location FROM ( SELECT d.id, d.device_id, d.online, d.temperature, d.humidity, d.collect_time, d.receive_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.device_id ORDER BY d.collect_time DESC, d.id DESC) AS rn FROM wms_env_data d ) t LEFT JOIN wms_env_device c ON c.device_id = t.device_id WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.device_id
